investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Meren Cargo (freight and logistics); Platform: Google Cloud southamerica-east1 (zones southamerica-east1-a/southamerica-east1-b/southamerica-east1-c); network range 10.11.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster meren-prod-southa (GKE); Public API api.meren.com is served by ingress-nginx with a Let's Encrypt certificate managed by cert-manager (ACME DNS-01); Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
